exercise1.prompt: A column with labels attached, and the labels travel with the data.

hiddenCases.name: the winner can be anywhere in the Series
the label is returned, not the score

exercise1.hint: idxmax gives the label of the largest value; max would give you the value itself, which is the other question.

questions.prompt: What does a Series have that a numpy array does not?
questions.explain: The index is the whole difference, and it is why two Series added together align on labels rather than on position.

questions.prompt: What is the difference between s.max() and s.idxmax()?
choices: max gives the value, idxmax gives its label
questions.explain: "How high was the best score" and "who got it" are different questions, and mixing them up is a common early bug.

choices: The scores above 85, with their labels
questions.explain: Masking works exactly as it does in numpy, and the labels come along with the values that survive.
